Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionPack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world! Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks. Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together. This Collector's Edition is packed with exclusive extras, enjoy bonus levels, a music player and achievements to keep the adventure alive. Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements. Family Journey is the cozy world tour you have been waiting for. Ready to explore? The collector's edition includes: - 60 stunning hidden object scenes across the globe! - 12 creative mini-games and brain-teasing puzzles. - A heartwarming family story of world travel. - Collector's Edition with exclusive bonus chapter. - Cozy gameplay the whole family will love. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesMinecraftReleases 10/27/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - MinecraftFantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingCreate, explore and survive alone or with friends.CREATE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play!VIBRANT VISUALS* Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER** Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS* - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE NINTENDO SWITCH™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. **Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account. Online multiplayer functionality requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately).Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Already own a digital version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™?
